checks.income_statement_identity: Sales revenue 6,545.4 + Other income and other revenue 262.9 - Operating expenses 5,540.3 - Share of results of associates 5.8 = 1,262.2 (= printed Operating profit); + Finance revenue 16.2 - Finance costs 143.7 - Net hyperinflation impact 8.4 = 1,126.3 vs printed PBT 1,126.3.
checks.identity_difference_note: 0.0 when the printed 'Finance revenue' (16.2) and hyperinflation (8.4) lines are included.
checks.note3_sum_check: Note 3 lines sum to 5,540.3 = income-statement Operating expenses (difference 0.0).
checks.intangibles_check: Note 15 goodwill 185.8 + software 35.3 + other 14.2 = 235.3 = balance sheet (difference 0.0).

issues: Single 'Operating expenses' line on the face (statement of comprehensive income); nature breakdown in Note 3. Classified as by_nature. No cost of sales or gross profit.
No separate raw materials line in FY2024 (embedded in 'Repairs and maintenance'): a by-nature materials series for Brambles breaks between FY2015 and FY2024.
PDF is two-up spreads: each PDF page holds two printed pages (PDF p44 = printed pp84-85). Printed page numbers here refer to the half of the spread holding the value.
2023 comparatives restated for a hyperinflation accounting-policy change; 2024 current-year figures are as originally reported.
Balance sheet combines goodwill with intangibles; PPE excludes right-of-use assets (773.7). AASB 16 means depreciation includes right-of-use assets, unlike FY2015.
